source: The game's own measure of its roads against the built model (tools/road_net_dump.js, 2026-11-27): the pieces it cuts at a wall, and those no car fits along; each by its ends in decimetres. Measured again, a piece still in the list is kept: one that has been opened is taken out by hand, or with FRESH=1.
steep_source: Inside the area a car can go, the pieces on which tools/car_edges.js finds your car, driven through, stops on dry, open road (pipeline/road_steep.py).
